title_zh: School life — 第24节可背诵讲义
body_en: Group projects teach school life skills. Divide jobs fairly and finish on time. Listen before you disagree. Write a short report the whole group can explain. If someone is quiet, invite them to share one idea. Success is the team’s work, not one star alone.
body_zh: 小组项目教学校生活技能。公平分工并按时完成。不同意之前先听。写一份全组都能讲解的短报告。若有人沉默，邀请他分享一个想法。成功是团队的工作，不是一颗明星独自完成。
